notes.2: PA18 is also the BSL button through J3 (not button S1, which is PA11): pull J3
notes.5: WARNING: Never drive PA21. On this LaunchPad BoosterPack pin 5 has no chip connection (R21 not fitted), and PA21 is the VREF- pin, tied to ground through R10. A pack that puts a high level on this pin drives that ground. A pack microphone that needs power on this pin needs a jumper from pin 8 to pin 5
notes.33: PA11 is the backchannel UART RX; the hello example uses TX only
notes.34: PA10 is the backchannel UART TX (BoosterPack gator-clip pin): console output
notes.40: PC17 is also button S2 through J4: pull J4
notes.39: J5 on the BoosterPack picks backlight (2-3) or red LED (1-2)

joy_sel_raw.note: PA21 is also ADC1_7: the port switches the pad between analog and digital input
